whoWeAre.heading: Who We Are — Custom Procurement & Order Fulfillment
paragraphs: Arseen Enterprises LTD is a UK-registered private limited company providing custom product procurement and international order fulfillment services. We serve both business clients (B2B) and individual consumers (B2C).

Our role is to coordinate customer-specific procurement, order preparation, packaging, international shipment and tracking through our sourcing and logistics network. Customers contract with and pay Arseen Enterprises LTD for their approved orders. Arseen Enterprises LTD coordinates procurement and fulfillment and bears the applicable procurement, processing and logistics costs associated with fulfilling those orders.
Independent suppliers, procurement coordinators and logistics providers support our fulfillment operations but do not separately collect customer payments through our website.

Our services operate primarily on a custom-order basis. Because products are procured according to customer requirements, we do not maintain a fixed online product catalog covering every item that may be requested. Customers contact us with their requirements and receive a quotation before placing an order.

items.title: Regulatory Compliance
items.desc: We operate under a formally registered UK private limited company structure, maintaining full legal and financial transparency. Procurement and fulfillment activities are conducted subject to applicable UK and international legal, sanctions, customs, export-control, carrier, and destination requirements.

items.title: Operational Transparency
items.desc: Customers receive written quotations before payment, clear order documentation, and honest communication at every stage. We believe trust is built through consistent, verifiable action — not promises.

items.title: International Reach
items.desc: We coordinate procurement and fulfillment across international sourcing and logistics networks, helping business clients (B2B) and individual consumers (B2C) receive their orders worldwide.
